name: prompt-helper
description: AI 提示词结构化工作台：把向 AI 提问变成按最佳实践填空的标准流程

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && node scripts/build.mjs clean && vite build && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:multi: vue-tsc --noEmit && node scripts/build.mjs clean && cross-env SINGLE_FILE=false vite build && node scripts/build.mjs multi
scripts.release: vue-tsc --noEmit && node scripts/build.mjs clean && vite build && node scripts/build.mjs release
